user_request: Tu ne vois pas assez la différence entre les différents assets. C'est juste le tube d'un canon qui est de plus en plus gros.
design_change: Distinct broad mount silhouettes rather than barrel scaling: open cradle with tall swivel pierriers, tall wheeled stepped carriages, long low wheel-less central axial slide with two projecting rails. Existing gameplay configurations unchanged.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE small Victoria 3 naval ship-designer armament UI icon, not a photograph, plan, full ship or scene.
Input image 1: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Match the simple painted embossed metallic glyph, dark bevel outline and broad shading of these tiny native bronze/silver/gold equipment icons.
Primary request: redesign the rejected galley armament family so the MOUNT and overall SILHOUETTE communicate the level even in grayscale at 32 pixels. Do not make three copies of the same fat cannon with progressively bigger tubes.
Composition: simple three-quarter isometric view, cannon mouths pointing upper-left. Complete centered glyph fills most of a square canvas with 10% transparent margin. Few large shapes, minimal engraved details, no tiny bolts or elaborate rope rigging. All surfaces including timber mounts use one monochrome metallic palette.
Transparency: genuine transparent blank background, solid opaque interiors. Crisp object edge, no exterior haze, glow, aura, halo or cast backdrop shadow. No text, numbers, labels, badges, modern mechanisms, motor, modern turret, water, sail, crew or decorative props.
BRONZE low tier: a LIGHT open triangular wooden bow cradle with two clearly separated upward fork posts at its corners. ONE short slender six-pounder cannon on the central low wedge/berceau, tilted slightly upward, no wheels. TWO very slim pierriers on taller swivel posts at either side; their handles and fork mounts give an unmistakable forked silhouette. The central cannon has a plain lightly tapered tube, not a giant modern-looking ringed barrel. Only a tiny triangular bow platform supporting these three weapons. Main read: low triangular cradle + two upright swivels, sparse/open/lightweight. Warm copper bronze finish. NOT a wheeled gun carriage, not rails.

qa.visual_inspection: Inspected full-size images and 180/64/32 px comparison. Tall fork posts visibly change bronze silhouette; enlarged stepped carriage and wheels characterize silver; long projecting rails dominate gold silhouette. Central gun plus two side weapons retained. Gold central slide has no wheels. At 32 px fine details and individual side mounts are limited; overall support outlines are more differentiated. Bronze base is trapezoidal, not the requested triangular outline. Silver barrel remains large and silver exterior halo is still visible despite no-glow prompt; do not claim this was completely eliminated. All raw alpha/painting preserved without retouch.

integration_note: V2 approved and installed: exact raw originals exported into three 120px DDS with seven mipmaps. Only aor_galley_guns_low/mid/high icon bindings changed; no costs, modifiers, technology, localization or starting fleets changed. V1 remains rejected and unused. No in-game test.
